profile.summary: Dhatre Udyog Limited manufactures and sells iron and steel products in India. The company offers TMT bars, rounds, squares, angles; and trading of billets, blooms, ingots, iron ores, etc. It also offers rebars, MS grade angels, flats, and wire rod coils.
